slides.title: DevAnalyzer
slides.tagline: A cross-platform desktop tool to analyze Gradle and Kotlin Multiplatform projects, clean build folders, manage SDK resources, and optimize development environments.

slides.title: Core Architecture & Capabilities
slides.tagline: Built with scalable patterns and modern tooling.
features: Analyze Gradle modules, plugins, dependencies, and configurations across Android, iOS, JVM, JS, Wasm, and Server targets
Inspect project metadata, including Kotlin, AGP, Gradle, SDK, NDK, and CMake versions
Browse Kotlin, Java, XML, Gradle scripts, and Version Catalog libraries inside the app

slides.title: Intuitive Workspace Diagnostics
slides.tagline: Engineered for smooth navigation and reactive state management.
features: Scan module build folders, calculate folder sizes, and safely delete selected build directories in batches
Analyze multiple workspace directories to identify active and potentially unused development resources
Cross-reference Android SDK Platforms, Build Tools, Sources, NDK, CMake, and Gradle resources with projects
